bias.en: Bearish · holding just above the 52-week low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 守在 52 周低点上方

read.en: MP Materials edged up 0.3% on Oct 20 to $39.05 on light volume, trading between $37.94 and $40.16. It remains below all its falling averages: the 5-day ($39.95), 10-day ($42.4), 30-day ($46.7), 100-day ($51.7) and 200-day ($56.1). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($45.70), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月20日小涨 0.3%，收于 $39.05，成交清淡，盘中区间 $37.94–40.16。股价仍位于全部下行均线下方：5 日（$39.95）、10 日（$42.4）、30 日（$46.7）、100 日（$51.7）和 200 日均线（$56.1）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$45.70），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The $37.94 low held just above the $37.81 Jul 29 52-week low; the high stalled at $40. Resistance is $40–40.2 (round number, 5-day average, Oct 20 high), then $42.4 (10-day) and $44.5–45.7 (Oct 1 low, SAR). Support is $38.6 (Oct 15 low), then $37.8 (52-week low) and $35. A close above $40.2 would target $42.4; a close below $37.8 would set a new 52-week low.
read.zh: 当日低点 $37.94 守在 $37.81 的 7月29日 52 周低点上方，高点则止步于 $40。阻力为 $40–40.2（整数关口、5 日均线、10月20日高点），其次 $42.4（10 日均线）和 $44.5–45.7（10月1日低点、抛物线 SAR）。支撑为 $38.6（10月15日低点），其次 $37.8（52 周低点）和 $35。若收盘站上 $40.2，下一目标看 $42.4；若收盘跌破 $37.8，将创 52 周新低。
